title: TypeScript style conformance
summary: The code style batch pass MUST apply the TypeScript style guidance this policy references to durable repository TypeScript and TSX.
instructions: Agents repairing TypeScript style MUST read the complete TypeScript style guidance this policy references, and MUST apply it before completion.
Agents MUST NOT reconstruct or separately load the formatter-owned appendix of the TypeScript style guidance unless they are changing formatter configuration or integration.
Agents MUST repair only the judgment-level TypeScript rules the style guidance states; the configured TypeScript formatter stays authoritative for mechanical style.

guidance_sources.read_trigger: Read this guidance before you repair TypeScript or TSX style.
